items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I think he was at the Nest Club when I first went down there.

ctx.x: Was he there when you joined the bad the first...? I think he was, wasn't he? He was kind of already...

I think so. I think so. [CHILTON SAYS HE JOINED RUSSELL IN 1927] I think he was at the Nest Club when I first went down there. Yeah, the Nest Club, where Russell was the piano player. Yeah, Bill Johnson. He used to sing...
Where was he from? Do you know?
